market_name: Will 12 or more Fed rate cuts happen in 2026?

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check whether the probability shift is corroborated by moves in fed funds futures / SOFR strip and 2Y yield; isolate signal from noise.
time_plan.1h: Compare TLT tick with 2Y and 10Y yields to confirm a genuine dovish repricing rather than an idiosyncratic Polymarket quote.
time_plan.2h: Look for any macro headline (labor data, credit event, geopolitical shock) that could justify emergency-cut pricing.
time_plan.6h: Reassess whether the rate-cut probability held or mean-reverted; check MOVE index for rate vol confirmation.
time_plan.12h: Evaluate whether TLT moved with rates repricing; if no corroborating rates move, treat the market signal as noise.

predictions.reasoning: A market pricing 12+ (=300bps) Fed cuts in 2026 is a deep-recession/emergency-easing tail scenario. A sharp rise in its implied probability would signal expectations of aggressive, possibly emergency, easing — bullish for duration as front-end and long-end yields fall. TLT is the cleanest liquid proxy for that rate move.

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Verify equity futures reaction and VIX; distinguish 'bad-news easing' from 'good-news soft-landing easing.'
time_plan.1h: Check credit spreads (HYG/LQD) for corroborating risk-off; cross-check with the TLT signal.
time_plan.2h: Scan for the catalyst driving deep-cut pricing; a benign disinflation story would flip equities positive, breaking this thesis.
time_plan.6h: Reassess direction — dovish easing without recession can lift equities, so watch whether risk-off persists.
time_plan.12h: Confirm whether equities and rates moved consistently with a recession-easing narrative; otherwise mark mapping weak.

predictions.reasoning: 12+ cuts implies severe economic distress (only plausible with a recession or systemic shock triggering emergency easing). If that tail probability spikes, equities would typically fall on growth/earnings fear despite easing hopes, since the easing is a response to crisis. SPY is the deepest liquid proxy.

evidence_used: Market implies 12+ 25bp cuts (=300bps) in 2026, an extreme tail requiring recession or emergency Fed action
Rate-cut expectations map directly to Treasury duration and risk assets
Emergency/large cuts historically coincide with crisis (2008, 2020) and equity drawdowns
uncertainty_notes: The 700bps tradable threshold is very unlikely to be met by any liquid ETF over 12h absent an actual crisis
Direction of equities is ambiguous: dovishness can be bullish (soft landing) or bearish (crisis) depending on cause
Polymarket quotes on tail strikes are thin and noisy; a probability move may reflect low liquidity, not information

llm_justification.summary: This market prices an extreme easing scenario (12+ cuts / 300bps in 2026), only realistic under recession or emergency Fed action. A sharp rise in its implied probability would signal crisis/deep-easing expectations, which map to higher long-duration Treasuries (TLT up) and, most likely, lower equities (SPY down) on growth fears. Both mappings are low-confidence, noisy, and almost certainly below the 700bps tradable bar over a 12h window.
key_assumptions: A probability spike reflects genuine macro information rather than thin-market noise
12+ cuts is interpreted as crisis-driven emergency easing, not benign disinflation
Rate and equity proxies react in standard risk-off/dovish fashion
failure_modes: The move is already public (priced into rates via FOMC data/CPI) so no incremental asset move
Benign soft-landing easing would lift equities, reversing the SPY thesis
Thin Polymarket tail-strike liquidity produces spurious probability moves with no asset linkage
Magnitude far below 700bps threshold, making the signal non-tradable even if directionally right
llm_justification.why_not_ex_post: The card is timestamped, content-hashed, and never overwritten. Execution must reject any card created after an anomaly's trigger time.
